skill2: ■ Activates when landing Full Charge attacks if self is in Battle Formation status. Affects self. ATK ▲ 20% for 3 sec.

caveats: ⚑ skill1 trigger: the engine has no self-status gate, so 'while not in Missile Guide status' is approximated by re-applying the Missile Guide buffs on EVERY shot (shotFired) with durationShots:3 + removeOnReload. With ammo 8 and a 3-round window the faithful gate also yields ~100% in-magazine uptime (rounds 1-3 / 4-6 / 7-8, cleared at reload), so the approximation should be damage-equivalent; it diverges only if the engine's shot cadence lets the 3-round window lapse mid-magazine.

⚑ skill1 'Full Charge attack' is keyed to shotFired on the assumption the sim always fires RL shots at full charge. If partial-charge shots exist in the engine, shotFired over-counts both the Missile Guide refresh and the skill2 266.6% rider.

⚑ skill2 ATK ▲20% (Battle Formation) is NOT modeled — the gating status is never granted by this kit and the schema has no self-status gate; modeling it ungated would grant a near-permanent 20% ATK. Under-credits if the status is externally supplied.

⚑ skill2 Projectile Explosion Damage ▲20% is encoded behind requiresTargetStatus:'Explosive Round'. No unit in this kit inflicts that status, so the block is currently INERT by design rather than dropped.
⚑ Rider crit: the 266.6% and 492.3% true-damage hits are authored crit:true per the rider convention (riders crit at the caster's rate, no core). Unverified for true-flavored damage on this unit.
⚑ Burst block ordering assumes the self True Damage ▲60% resolves before the 492.3% burst nuke, so the nuke benefits from it. Not stated by the kit text.
⚑ Cadence/economy inputs (ammo 8, chargeFrames 120, reloadFrames 142) are datamine-sourced and unreliable; charge-speed ▲100% makes shots-fired highly sensitive to them.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. RL/Fire/Attacker/Burst III charge unit. Skill 1 is a self-sustaining Missile Guide loop: each full-charge shot grants Charge Speed ▲100% and Charge Damage ▲58.5% for 3 rounds, cleared on reload-to-max (removeOnReload) — a weapon-state modifier that raises shots fired, not a cosmetic. Skill 2 adds a 266.6%-of-final-ATK true-damage rider per full-charge landing, plus two gated self-buffs: the Explosive-Round-gated Projectile Explosion ▲20% is encoded behind requiresTargetStatus (inert with no carrier), and the Battle-Formation-gated ATK ▲20% is unmodeled (no self-status gate primitive). Burst is a 492.3% true-damage nuke plus a 10s self True Damage ▲60%; explosion radius is unmodeled (no damage channel on a partless boss). FB-by-timing left at the default (no noFb set); noRange is engine-automatic.

flags.reasoning: The kit gates the grant on 'while not in Missile Guide status' — a self-status the schema cannot express. Refreshing every shot makes the buffs continuously live; the faithful gate would fire on rounds 1, 4, 7 of an 8-round magazine and, with a 3-round window, still covers every round, so the two should be damage-equivalent. The risk is any engine path where the round counter decrements without the buff being re-applied.
flags.recipe: Instrument buffApply for stat chargeSpeedPct/chargeDamagePct over one magazine and confirm the apply frames and durationShots; then A/B the refresh-every-shot model against a gated variant (apply only when no live Missile Guide buff) and confirm identical total damage.

flags.estimate: 2.0s base full charge → 1.0s under Charge Speed ▲100%; 8 rounds/magazine; ~2.37s reload
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ cadence tuple: chargeFrames/reloadFrames/ammo are datamine-sourced and known-unreliable. Charge Speed ▲100% doubles shot count, so total damage is roughly linear in these three values — an error here dominates every other error in the model.
flags.recipe: Count full-charge shots per magazine and time reload→first-shot in a scope-lock recording; compare against the sim's shot event stream for the same window.

flags.field: skill1 — does the TRIGGERING shot get Charge Damage ▲58.5%?
flags.estimate: assumed YES for the triggering shot's own damage if the engine applies block effects before damage resolution; charge SPEED can only affect the NEXT charge either way
flags.reasoning: 'Activates when performing a Full Charge attack' is ambiguous about whether the buff lands before or after that shot's damage. Charge Speed is unambiguous (it can only help the next charge), but Charge Damage ▲58.5% on shot 1 of a magazine is worth a full shot's worth of the charge bucket per reload cycle.
flags.recipe: Read the first post-reload popup value against the second in footage; a first-shot value ~58.5pp lower in the charge bucket means the buff lands after the triggering shot.

flags.estimate: crit: true on both true-damage hits (caster sheet crit rate, no core)
flags.reasoning: Per the rider convention, function-damage riders crit at the caster's rate and get no core unless the text says 'core strike damage'. Neither line says core. Whether TRUE-flavored damage is crit-eligible in game is not established by the kit text.
flags.recipe: Count orange (crit) vs white popups for the 266.6% rider across a magazine in a recording; a 0% crit share refutes crit:true for true damage.

flags.estimate: 0% uptime assumed (block omitted); true value is either 0% or ~100% uptime while firing
flags.reasoning: The status is not granted anywhere in this kit, and there is no self-status block gate. Omitting under-credits by up to ATK ▲20% for effectively the whole fight if some teammate/system supplies Battle Formation; encoding it ungated would over-credit by the same amount. Omission is the honest default.
flags.recipe: Identify what grants Battle Formation. If a teammate grants it, add the block with a teamHas gate on that unit; if it is a squad/system state, declare a `modes` array (default off) and gate the block on the mode.

flags.estimate: gate never opens → block inert (0 damage contribution today)

If Vesti's own rockets in fact apply Explosive Round in game, the +20% Projectile Explosion is near-permanent and this is a real under-credit.
flags.recipe: Check whether the boss shows an Explosive Round debuff icon while this unit fires; if she self-applies it, add a targetStatus effect (target enemy) on the shotFired block with the observed duration.

flags.field: burst block order (self buff before enemy nuke)
flags.estimate: True Damage ▲60% applied first, so the 492.3% burst hit is multiplied by it
flags.reasoning: Both blocks fire on the same burstCast; the kit lists the self buff first, and the sim resolves blocks in array order. If the game snapshots the nuke before the buff, the burst hit is over-credited by 60pp of the Damage Up bucket.
flags.recipe: Compare the burst popup value against a sim run with the two burst blocks swapped; match the ratio to a recorded burst popup.
